content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate observed for MyriadCorp (dedicated VPC pool: pool-47) — 10m spike, 60% 503s, autoretry rate up 3x :rotating_light:

erin (oncall): seeing it, paging sam and leo. are customer-facing APIs 503-ing for all tenants or just Myriad?
sam (eng-sre): looks like only tenants pinned to pool-47. MyriadCorp traffic is >90% on that pool by routing policy. other tenants on pool-47 also seeing elevated tail latency but fewer 5xx.
leo (eng-runtime): digging logs — garbage collection spikes on node-gpu-12 plus a KV cache thrash. metrics: mem_pressure high, kv_hit_rate dropped from 0.92 -> 0.45.

erin (oncall): quick mitigation options: 1) evict Myriad back to warm fallback pool (canary slower) 2) drain node-gpu-12 and move pods 3) throttle batch sizes for pool-47 4) temporary routing to fallback pool. thoughts?
sam (eng-sre): prefer routing fallback + drain node. eviction will require tenant-specific config change (will disrupt sessions).
leo (eng-runtime): I can trigger node drain and move KV shards but it will take ~6-8m to rebalance. routing switch is faster.

ops-bot: runbook step triggered by erin: "dedicated-pool-incident" — checklist started, paging escalation to oncall-sre.

erin (oncall): @julia heads-up — customer MyriadCorp likely impacted. please prep comms. account link: https://crm/myriadcorp
julia (acct-mgr): on it. do we have ETA for mitigation? customers are already messaging CSM. need single-sentence status for exec.
sam (eng-sre): immediate ETA: switching routing now should reduce 5xx in ~30s for new traffic. in-flight requests may still see failures. drain + rebalance 6-12m to fully stabilize.

erin (oncall): executing routing change: `POST /internal/routing/switch?pool=pool-47&target=fallback-warm-2 --data '{"tenant":"myriad"}'`

leo (eng-runtime): routing change applied. verifying.

sam (eng-sre): seeing 5xx drop to 12% -> 4% within 45s. KV hit rate recovering.

erin (oncall): nice. leaving node drain in progress. will monitor for rollback triggers.

julia (acct-mgr): message to MyriadCorp CSM drafted: "We're experiencing an infrastructure incident affecting your dedicated pool. We have routed new traffic to a fallback pool which is reducing errors. We're continuing to drain and heal nodes; we'll update with an expected resolution in 1 hour. Your account team is available for questions." want to add SLA / credit note?
julia (acct-mgr): CSM suggested offering temporary priority burst capacity or a pro-rated credit for downtime. need engineering sign-off on impact window.
sam (eng-sre): based on metrics, customer-facing errors >5xx lasted approx 00:07:20 from spike start until routing took effect. backfilled retries may have extended perceived impact for some sessions.

erin (oncall): agree. record impact window as 7m20s starting 1850123400 -> 1850123820 (approx).

ops-bot: note added to incident log: "MyriadCorp dedicated pool partial outage; routing fallback applied; node-gpu-12 drain initiated."

leo (eng-runtime): follow-up — found a kernel regression in the streaming path that surfaced under high concurrent KV misses. commit abc1234 rolled to pool-47 yesterday. pushing rollback to pool-47 now.`

sam (eng-sre): rolling back abc1234 on pool-47. command: ```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-pool-47 --to-revision=12
```

leo (eng-runtime): rollback done. monitoring for regressions.

sam (eng-sre): post-rollback metrics look stable, 5xx <1% across pool-47, KV hit rate back to baseline.

erin (oncall): handing off to night oncall sam_night for post-incident follow-up @ 1850125000. I'm going offline in 10. key actions: confirm no residual errors, confirm Myriad sessions recovered, coordinate customer RCA.
sam (eng-sre): ack. I'll run the health sweep and collect logs for RCA.
julia (acct-mgr): drafting customer-facing post-incident note and exec summary. will include timeline, impact window, root cause (regression in streaming kernel), mitigation steps (routing fallback + rollback), and remediation plan.

--- 2 hours later (follow-up) ---

sam (eng-sre): final status: pool-47 healthy, all Myriad traffic stable on their pinned pool. no further elevated 5xx in last 90m. collecting artifact links: logs: https://logs/replay/1850123456, grafana: https://grafana/d/pool-47/overview

julia (acct-mgr): customer comms sent at 1850128900: "We experienced a short-lived incident affecting your dedicated inference pool. We mitigated by routing traffic to a fallback pool and rolling back a recent runtime change; services were fully restored within ~8 minutes. We will follow up with a formal RCA and proposed credits if applicable." Myriad asked for executive note and SLA credit estimate.

sam (eng-sre): preliminary RCA bullet points for review: - Incident triggered by streaming kernel regression (commit abc1234) under KV cache miss storm - Regression caused GC pressure + KV thrashing on GPUs leading to 503s - Immediate mitigations: routing traffic to fallback pool, drain affected node, rollback commit - Long-term fix: add canary gating for streaming kernels + auto-eviction thresholds + improved KV telemetry hooks

leo (eng-runtime): technical detail to include: regression introduced an allocation loop when `kv_get` returned miss, causing repeated allocations per token. reproducer attached in logs link. patch in review: patch/streaming-kernel-fix-1850

erin (oncall): exec summary draft (one paragraph): "On DATE at HH:MM UTC, MyriadCorp experienced a brief disruption to their dedicated inference pool due to a runtime regression that surfaced under a KV cache miss storm. We reduced customer impact within ~8 minutes by routing traffic to a fallback pool and rolling back the offending runtime change. We're instituting additional canary checks and telemetry to prevent recurrence. Our team will propose a pro-rated credit and is available for an immediate call."

julia (acct-mgr): sla calc: outage 8 minutes on a monthly SLA of 99.95% for dedicated pools. monthly minutes = 43,200. outage fraction = 8/43200 = 0.000185 -> credit band per contract = 10% for outage > 5m? (placeholder) will confirm legal/finance.

sam (eng-sre): next steps assigned: 1) leo - finalize patch and deploy canary to 3% of pools (owner) 2) infra - add auto-evict on KV miss spike (owner TBD) 3) acct - send formal RCA and credit proposal to Myriad (julia) 4) eng-sre - postmortem doc (sam)

julia (acct-mgr): scheduling exec call for tomorrow 16:00 UTC w/ Myriad execs and our CTO. will send calendar invite.

erin (oncall): closing the incident channel thread for live mitigation. plz move RCA to /docs/incidents/1850123456-myriad-rca-draft.md and tag owners.

ops-bot: incident closed by erin (oncall) at 1850126640. severity: P2.

sam (eng-sre): leaving notes: duration recorded 00:08:20, root cause tagged "runtime-kernel-regression-abc1234", SLO impact minimal.

julia (acct-mgr): final note — customer appreciated quick routing and exec availability. requested detailed timeline and evidence of fix. will follow up after patch deploy. :white_check_mark:
